question: Who was appointed as the Chairman of National Financial Reporting Authority in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajay Bhushan Prasad Pandey.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA) **had nominated **Ajay Bhushan Pandey **as its chairman for a** three-year term.**
 
• In **February 2021**, Pandey—an **IAS official **from the **Maharashtra cadre **and a **1984 graduate**—retired as the **revenue secretary.**
 
• The appointment of former revenue secretary **ABP Pandey **as **chairperson **of the **NFRA **for a term of three years beginning on the date of assumption of responsibility or until the incumbent turns** 65 years old** was **authorised **by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC).
 
• The **NFRA **oversees the **auditing industry **as an **impartial authority**.
 
• The **organisation **has the **authority **to **examine **the **financial statements **of **businesses**, look for justifications, and look into irregularities including accounting and auditing difficulties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Under the **Companies Act **of **2013**, the **National Financial Reporting Authority **(NFRA) was established as an independent authority to supervise the **auditing industry **and the **Indian Accounting Standards.**
 
• It started operating in** October 2018.**
 
• The **Standing Committee **on **Finance **first floated the idea of the National Financial Reporting Authority in its **21st report** in the wake of the **Satyam affair in 2009.**
 
• Following that, the** Companies Act of 2013 **provided the **legal framework **for its **structure **and **constitution**.
 
• **On March 1st, 2018,** the **Union Cabinet** approved the proposal for its foundation.
 
• It is hoped that the **NFRA's **establishment as an independent regulator of the **auditing industry **will increase the **accuracy **and **dependability **of the **financial information **and **statements **that large unlisted companies and listed corporations in India present.
